title: Overcoming multidrug resistance Acinetobacter baumanii via downregulated virulence factor genes by green fabricated silver Nanoparticles mediated Piper nigrum

title: Porphyromonas gingivalis outer membrane vesicles promote alveolar bone resorption by increasing the local RANKL/OPG ratio in experimental periodontitis model rats
task: Elucidate Porphyromonas gingivalis OMV mechanisms in alveolar bone resorption
key_results: Pg-OMVs increased RANKL/OPG ratio in periodontal tissues; promoted osteoclast differentiation in RAW264.7 cells and suppressed osteoblast mineralization in MC3T3-E1 cells; significantly increased bone resorption in vivo
comments: Well-designed in vitro and in vivo study but mechanistic details of OMV-cell interaction and specific bacterial factors remain incompletely defined.

title: Box A of HMGB1 plasmid reverses the age-related changes in the plasma proteomic profile of perimenopausal monkeys
task: Assess HMGB1 Box A plasmid effects on age-related proteomic changes in perimenopausal primates
key_results: Box A plasmid treatment reversed age-related proteomic changes; APOE and SHBG levels restored toward young adult levels; differential expression in stress response, immune regulation, and lipid transport proteins
comments: Interesting proof-of-concept but limited sample size (n=8 treated, n=3 controls), single timepoint analysis, and unclear mechanistic link between Box A and DNA damage response limit conclusions.

model_io.model: Cynomolgus macaque plasma proteomics with Box A plasmid

hypotheses.hypothesis: Box A domain reverses age-related plasma proteomic alterations
